title: I made an ai dungeon master with claire obscure parrying
author: thisGuyJhon
selftext:
Hello all,
   I have spent a year making an ai dungeon master game. I wanted more depth and immersion with item variety, builds, companions, crafting, and end game. It started with just story telling but evolved into turn based combat that is fun! You can try it out in any browser at https://requiemofrealms.com/info . Just hit the “try combat” in any browser. I released on iOS and am trying to get it to google play but it’s not easy being a 1 man shop. Thanks for reading this!

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: I thought there will be some actions, but I really like the design, really fits into the theme. Many would love to try it. Would you be able to share it to [vibecdinglist.com](http://vibecdinglist.com) so other users can give valuable feedback too?

replies.author: thisGuyJhon
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. I’ll check out that site as well. Appreciate you!

comments.author: thisGuyJhon
comments.body: Update: In closed beta testing for google play! So hopefully we can get it out in 2 weeks! Fingers crossed.

comments.author: thisGuyJhon
comments.body: Oh we are live on google play! [https://requiemofrealms.com/info](https://requiemofrealms.com/info)
